paragraphs.text: The Clan of the Gentle Wave was one of the clans of the sea dwarves on Ulgrotha .

The few Dwarven ships that are still being sailed are now relics of the time when the Dwarves were building the Castle of Morning Light . These ships are made of the strongest wooden beams and the best forged metal, and were built to protect the trading ships from the dangerous creatures of the sea. Each ship has a Dwarven family that has crewed it for hundreds of years, and all are well versed in the wonders of astronomy, the sea, and the plane where they live in. Reveka comes from this clan.
